Metadata.title: Grucore — Premium Construction Guatemala
Metadata.description: Premium construction and remodeling company in Guatemala. Residential and commercial projects with the highest quality standards.

meta.title: Grucore — Premium Construction & Remodeling
meta.description: We build extraordinary spaces in Guatemala. Residential, commercial and industrial projects with premium standards.

services.title: Solutions for every type of project
services.subtitle: From residential remodeling to large-scale commercial development, our team covers the full project lifecycle.

items.title: Residential Construction
items.description: We design and build the home you imagined, with premium materials and on-time delivery.

items.title: Interior Remodeling
items.description: We transform existing spaces with design precision and clean execution, minimizing disruption to your daily routine.

items.title: Commercial Projects
items.description: Offices, retail spaces, restaurants and mixed developments. We meet timelines because we understand the cost of every delay.

items.title: Design + Build
items.description: Architecture, engineering and execution under a single contract. Reducing coordination time and eliminating inconsistencies between plans and site.

items.title: Industrial Construction
items.description: Warehouses, industrial facilities and production plants. Efficient structures focused on operational functionality.

items.title: Premium Finishes
items.description: Flooring, ceilings, fine carpentry, paint and closing details. The last 20% that makes the visual difference.

process.title: A clear process from the first contact

steps.title: Initial consultation
steps.description: We evaluate your project at no cost. Within 24 hours you have a response and a dedicated advisor who will be your single point of contact throughout.

steps.title: Planning & budget
steps.description: We prepare plans, technical specifications and a detailed budget. No surprises: every line item is documented before we break ground.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: We build with daily supervision. You receive progress updates, photos and access to your client portal in real time.

steps.title: Delivery & warranty
steps.description: Formal handover with detailed walkthrough, resolved punch list and work warranty. Your space, ready to move in.

before_after.title: Before and after says it all

pricing.title: No surprises. Real ranges by project type.
pricing.subtitle: We publish ranges based on executed projects. The exact quote depends on specifications, materials and location. Always free.
pricing.disclaimer: * Prices in Guatemalan Quetzales (GTQ). Include standard labor and materials. Premium finishes are additional.
